description: IPC for the bundled UI window only. No remote origin is listed, so remote content gets no IPC at all. The HTTP plugin's scope is NOT here: it is granted at runtime for the connected deployment's origin only (see http_scope.rs). The opener hands only https and loopback http to the system browser (the scope is a glob: `[[]`/`[]]` are literal brackets, and any http URL with userinfo is denied so `http://localhost:x@host` cannot pass as loopback).
